publications.title: From Court Statistics to Better Justice Policy
publications.subtitle: Understanding Caseload, Case Clearance, and Pending Cases in Indonesia's Judiciary
publications.research_question: How can consistently defined and verifiable court statistics help judicial policymakers understand workload, identify operational pressures, and improve access to timely justice?
publications.source_scope: Mahkamah Agung RI Annual Reports, Kepaniteraan Annual Reports, LKjIP, Official Releases

publications.title: Measuring Access to Justice and Legal Aid
publications.subtitle: Evaluating Posbakum, Prodeo, and Court Fee Waivers Across Indonesia
publications.research_question: How effectively do court-based legal aid and fee-waiver mechanisms reach underserved litigants?
publications.source_scope: Badilum, Badilag, BPHN Legal Aid Reports

publications.title: Judicial Resources and Institutional Capacity
publications.subtitle: Analyzing Judicial Staffing, Budget Allocation, and Caseload Density
publications.research_question: How do judicial staffing and budget distributions align with regional caseload pressures?

publications.title: Court Efficiency, Timeliness, and Case Management
publications.subtitle: Benchmarking On-Time Case Processing and Minutation Turnaround
publications.research_question: Where do delays occur between case registration, decision, and judgment dispatch?
publications.source_scope: Kepaniteraan MA-RI, SIPP Aggregate Timeliness Logs
